full_details: It was the worst day of the cold. Cowley came as far as Mistress Ansell allowed, with the part already learned, and asked which correction was current. You told him the second, Ephesus and not Epidamnum at the third speech, and you tried to give the reason. He would not take the reason. She set bread and broth between you. You stayed in bed. Errors played at the Cross Keys at two without you, and nobody in the room treated that as a favour you were doing the company. The Rose bill was 1 Caesar. You did not go, and you did not hear it. By evening the fever was at its height. A line you had struck went back onto the page, because you could not tell whether it was bad.
one_sentence: Cowley took Egeon at two, and you stayed in bed with the fever at its height.
title: Stayed in bed while Cowley took Egeon
